decision.title: Should the repository enable automatic dependency updates now?
decision.summary: Enable grouped patch updates, block automatic majors, and measure patch latency before claiming improvement.

claims.text: The policy can group patch updates while reserving majors for manual review.

evidence.excerpt: Patch updates can be grouped weekly while major versions remain blocked for manual compatibility review.

claims.text: Major dependency updates are safe to merge automatically without compatibility review.

evidence.excerpt: An automated major upgrade broke the plugin API and required a rollback before the next release.

claims.text: Automation will cut median patch-update latency in half.

evidence.excerpt: Patch updates can be grouped weekly while major versions remain blocked for manual compatibility review.

claims.limitation: Neither synthetic source contains before-and-after merge-latency measurements.
